answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, verified by independent peers. A new identity starts with no trust, like a shallow lagoon, and must earn standing through honest work over time; faking thousands of identities means funding thousands of stakes, so a Sybil flood costs real capital per clone. Cheaters forfeit the bond, and the ivory tower of a single fake reputation collapses, because trust is anchored in basalt-solid, auditable history rather than cheap claims.
